note: Cases mirror validate_config_field for the object, tier, secret, event and pattern knobs. Expectations are the compiler's findings on the same program (orb validate --json), one finding per case so the order is fixed. The pattern and operator registries are hand-written subsets of LINT_PATTERNS and LINT_OPERATOR_NAMES.

findings.message: Config field uses banned type 'object'. Declare a named struct alias (e.g. `type FieldConfig = { name: string, label: string }`) and use the alias (`[FieldConfig]`) so the catalog + TS codegen carry real types. For inline render-ui trees, use the `render-ui` type instead.
findings.suggestion: Author the shape: `type <Name> = { field1: <T1>, field2: <T2> }`, then use `[<Name>]` (for arrays) or `<Name>` (for single objects) on the config field. For render-ui trees use `: render-ui`.

findings.message: Config field uses banned type '[object]'. Declare a named struct alias (e.g. `type FieldConfig = { name: string, label: string }`) and use the alias (`[FieldConfig]`) so the catalog + TS codegen carry real types. For inline render-ui trees, use the `render-ui` type instead.
